column1: # Instructor roster (PRD 35 §4.6). Pipe-delimited:
#   name|round|tier|instance_type|pids|bootstrap|owner
# OWNER is what splits the roster into per-presenter sets. Each presenter gets their own round 1, 2 and
# 3, and provisioning shows a presenter only their own clusters rather than all nine. It is an explicit
# column, not a convention, because "the -1 suffix means Michael" is exactly the kind of rule that lives
# in one person's head and is wrong six weeks later. An empty owner means shared/unassigned.
# The owner also drives the friendly hostname: owner + round -> michael-round1.agenticburn.com. Note the
# single label. The TLS certificate is *.agenticburn.com, which covers ONE level, so a nested name like
# roundone.michael.agenticburn.com does not validate and fails to connect at all (verified 2026-08-27).
# Empty column = default: tier -> gitops default (Nova); instance_type -> cluster module default;
# pids -> module default (1024). R1 sets pids=-1 so the C4 fork bomb burns the uncapped node.
# NOTE: the tier column is parsed + passed through, but the per-cluster model patch (§4.6-d) is NOT yet
# wired, so every cluster currently runs the gitops default model (Nova) regardless of tier.
# Change what the fleet provisions here (or point WIB_ROSTER_FILE elsewhere); no fleet.sh edit needed.
# Subset a run without editing this file: WIB_ROUNDS=2,3 and/or WIB_PER_ROUND=1.
watch-it-burn-r1-1|1|||-1|burn|michael
watch-it-burn-r1-2|1|||-1|burn|whitney
watch-it-burn-r1-3|1|||-1|burn|
